verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS data-activation platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack does not document a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of Hightouch. The community note that customer data stays in the customer's own warehouse describes data residency in a hosted architecture, which is an adjacent capability and not self-hosting the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
